cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've marked a cross beside the dripping tap. I've crossed out the whole sink. Shall we pull it out together?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That cross is where the washer packet goes. I was marking things on the shopping list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the shopping list. Add a sink and a worktop; we'll need both while we're sorting the tap.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The worktop goes under every cupboard. We can't just lift it out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put cupboards on the list too, then. I'll copy your measurements; we can finally move the sink to the other wall.

reason: Make misunderstood marking enlarge the shopping/removal scope, with cupboards forcing the larger layout disruption.
